'''Tormax Ardellian''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] Rebels and equipment to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. They were discovered in the act; the Rebels were publicly [[Death/Legends|executed]] and the pirates locked away in [[Bandor's Palace|Moff Bandor's palace]]. Ardellian escaped, although his face was wounded.
